- Smaller app: the torrent engine's native part (libtorrent, 16 MB on the phone and 6 MB of the APK) is no longer built in: it is fetched once, the first time a torrent is downloaded (6 MB, from Maven Central, checked by its SHA-256), and kept in the app's folder. The photo recogniser of the gallery search (5 MB) is fetched the same way the first time the pictures are read. The x86_64 libraries (emulators and Chromebooks) and the 1 MB tables of a post-quantum signature never used here are left out. The full APK is about 18 MB smaller, the space on the phone about 35 MB less.
- Downloads, Series and movies: when the add-on gave nothing, every episode showed "—" and the download buttons did nothing, with no word why. The add-on's answer is now checked: a refusal (an HTTP error or a protection web page instead of a list) is said under the list ("The add-on did not answer: HTTP 403"), the request looks like a phone browser's, and a stream that does not say its size is no longer thrown away (the first one is taken when none says it).
- Downloads, Series: every episode has a new button that lists all its streams (quality, source and size, the ones under the size limit marked): one is chosen and downloaded, instead of only the one picked by size. Each season card shows a picture of its own (its first episode's), not the same series poster for all.
- Ambient sounds (Focus, White noise): the 20 built-in loops (8 MB) were inside the app and copied once more into its folder, so they took twice the space. They are now fetched once, the first time the sounds are listed (from this project's repository at a fixed commit, each checked by its SHA-256); offline, the ones not fetched yet stay hidden until the next time.
